evals.name: retain-first-depot
evals.prompt: For each parcel, retain its first depot and count subsequent scans. Rebuild from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Deterministic public static Reduce on the model.
assertions: Handles null previous state using the first scan.
Retains the original depot while incrementing later counts.
Replays two interleaved keys with independent results.

evals.name: remove-clock-dependency
evals.prompt: My reducer stamps DateTime.Now during replay. Propose a stable alternative.
evals.expected_output: Uses a value recorded in the fact.
assertions: Takes the timestamp from the committed input.
Does not consult the current clock during reduction.
Compares replayed state to the same ordered facts.

evals.name: prefer-mapping
evals.prompt: Our read model just copies the display label from each event. Do we need to write a Reduce method?
evals.expected_output: Uses a projection for a straight mapping.
assertions: Does not introduce a live service dependency to read one label.
Explains why copying a field needs no prior state.
